```{r}

adult_features <- read.delim("all_features_2023_2024_scm_adults.csv", sep = ",")
adult_features

```

```{r}

adult_features <- adult_features %>%
  mutate(date_collected = as.Date(date_collected, '%Y-%m-%d')) %>%
  mutate_at(c('field_id', "previous_crop", "cover_crop", "manure", "tillage"), as.factor) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-c('X', 'total_scm', 'scm_male', 'scm_female', 'florilega', 'n_scm_m_1',
                   'n_scm_f_1', 'n_scm_m_2', 'n_scm_f_2', 'n_d_florilega_1', 'n_d_florilega_2'))


adult_features <- adult_features %>%
    mutate(previous_crop = case_when(previous_crop == 'Silage Corn' ~ 'Corn',
                           previous_crop == 'Grain Corn' ~ 'Corn',
                           previous_crop == 'Soybean' ~ 'Soybean',
                           TRUE ~ 'Other'))
  

adult_features <-adult_features %>% mutate_at('soil_texture', as.factor)
adult_features <-adult_features %>% mutate_at('year', as.factor)
adult_features <-adult_features %>% mutate_at('previous_crop', as.factor)

#adult_features$date_collected_numeric <- as.numeric(adult_features$date_collected)
#adult_features$planting_date_numeric <- as.numeric(adult_features$planting_date)

adult_features_rf <- adult_features %>% dplyr::select(-c('year', 'field_id'))

adult_features


```

```{r}

plot(fitdist(adult_features$total_flies,"nbinom"))

```

```{r}
# Boruta with all features 

boruta <- Boruta(total_flies ~ ., data = na.exclude(adult_features_rf), doTrace = 2, maxRuns = 500)

print(boruta)

png("boruta.png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300)
plot(boruta, las = 2, cex.axis = 0.35)

results <- attStats(boruta)
ordered_features <- results[order(-results$medianImp), ]
ordered_features

TentativeRoughFix(boruta, averageOver = Inf)


```



```{r}


# Rerun model on 10/2 after random forest importance changed :( - but with mean temp instead of max

options(na.action = "na.omit")

dredge_data <- adult_features 


model_10_2.1 <- glmer.nb(total_flies ~ (scale(week) + 
                                      scale(tmean_f) + 
                                      scale(prop_ag_current_year_1000m) + 
                                      scale(prop_nat_current_year_1000m) + 
                                      scale(ph) + 
                                        tillage +
                                        cover_crop)^2 + 
                                      (1 | field_id), 
                                      data = dredge_data)

summary(model_10_2.1)

vif_values <- vif(model_10_2.1)
vif_values


```


```{r}


# UPDATED MODEL AS OF 10/12/2026

options(na.action = "na.fail")


global_formula <- total_flies ~ (scale(week) + 
                                      scale(tmean_f) + 
                                      scale(prop_ag_current_year_1000m) + 
                                      scale(prop_nat_current_year_1000m) + 
                                      scale(ph) + 
                                        tillage +
                                        cover_crop)^2 + 
                                      (1 | field_id)

best_theta <- getME(model_10_2.1, "glmer.nb.theta")
fast_control <- glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
                             optCtrl = list(maxfun = 100000))

fast_model_10_2.1 <- glmer(global_formula, 
                     data = dredge_data, 
                     family = negative.binomial(theta = best_theta),
                     control = fast_control)

num_cores <- detectCores() - 1
clus <- makeCluster(num_cores)

clusterEvalQ(clus, {
  library(lme4)
  library(MuMIn)
})
clusterExport(clus, varlist = c("dredge_data", "fast_model_10_2.1", "fast_control", "best_theta"))


model_10_2.1_dredge <- dredge(fast_model_10_2.1, cluster = clus, trace = TRUE, rank = "AICc",  m.max = 10, fixed = ~ scale(week) + scale(tmean_f))
stopCluster(clus)

# model_10_2.1_dredge <- dredge(model_10_2.1, trace = TRUE, rank = "AICc")
nrow(model_10_2.1_dredge)
model_10_2.1_dredge[1,]

best_10_2.1 <- get.models(model_10_2.1_dredge, delta==0)[[1]]
summary(best_10_2.1)


vif_values <- vif(best_10_2.1)
vif_values

```

```{r}


# UPDATED MODEL AS OF 10/12/2026 WITH YEAR 

options(na.action = "na.fail")


global_formula_year <- total_flies ~ (scale(week) +

fast_model_10_2.1_year<- glmer(global_formula_year, 
                     data = dredge_data, 
                     family = negative.binomial(theta = best_theta),
                     control = fast_control)

num_cores <- detectCores() - 1

  library(lme4)
  library(MuMIn)

model_10_2.1_year_dredge <- dredge(fast_model_10_2.1_year, cluster = clus, trace = TRUE, rank = "AICc",  m.max = 10, fixed = ~ scale(week) + scale(tmean_f))
```

- VPD max
- Prop nat, previous year, 1000m
- pH

```{r}

ag_temp_effect <- Effect(c("prop_ag_current_year_1000m", "tmean_f"), best_10_2.1_year)
plot(ag_temp_effect, lines=list(col='#287a8c'), multiline = TRUE)


week_temp_effect <- Effect(c("week", "tmean_f"), best_10_2.1_year)
plot(week_temp_effect, lines=list(col='#287a8c'), multiline = TRUE)



```


```{r}

ag_temp_effect <- Effect(c("prop_ag_current_year_1000m", "tmean_f"), best_10_2.1_year, xlevels = list(week = c(20, 40, 60, 80)))

adult_features$temp_group <- cut(adult_features$tmean_f, 
                    breaks = c(20, 40, 60, 80), 
                    include.lowest = TRUE)

ggplot(adult_features, aes(x = prop_ag_current_year_1000m, y = total_flies, color = temp_group)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +                                # Raw data points
  geom_smooth(method = "glm.nb", se = FALSE, size = 1, color='black') +     # Interaction slopes
  facet_wrap(adult_features$temp_group) +
  facet_grid(cols=vars(adult_features$temp_group)) +
  theme_bw()


```

```{r}

week_temp_effect <- Effect(c("week", "tmean_f"), best_10_2.1_year, xlevels = list(week = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 51)))

adult_features$week_group <- cut(adult_features$week, 
                    breaks = c(10, 20, 30, 40, 51),
```
